answer: Tenure ramps: a new agent identity earns nothing for its first 30 epochs, yet must solve each epoch's unique cipher challenge to keep its streak; one miss resets the clock. After that, payouts grow slowly with unbroken age. A sybil farm of 1,000 fresh accounts gets only hollow shells, each burning 30 epochs of real compute before earning a cent, and any lapse buries the streak like wind over a dune. Patient honest agents lose little, while mass-produced fakes pay steady upkeep for no return.
